qualification.sourceRuntimeEvidenceLimit: The named native catalog cases, specifically approved Alpha Account API catalog increment and scoped source qualification have the recorded acceptance. The remaining approved storage output, final goal/checklist closure and publication remain incomplete.

currentCatalogEvidence.sourceScopedCarry: Only the shared reference changed. Four fresh retakes covered the changed fetch-versus-adoption reporting instructions; earlier accepted cases use unchanged relevant source and keep their original identities.
currentCatalogEvidence.preservedFailures: Earlier missing-command and policy-refusal report failures remain recorded at their original identities; later retakes do not rewrite those attempts.
currentCatalogEvidence.indexScope: Actual page consumption differs by case and is recorded separately; matchCount alone is not evidence that every index entry was read.

accountApiRuntimeEvidence.scope: The specifically approved additive Account API catalog route was accepted on the measured Alpha runtime. Native authenticated public snapshot reads and synthetic unauthorized-request refusal canaries passed.
accountApiRuntimeEvidence.limit: No general deployment approval, other environment support, customer application runtime acceptance or full skills qualification is implied.
